answer: Every operator backs all its identities with one shared horizon pool of 500,000 POA per identity, held in the garden vault. When a falcon audit proves any single identity fake, the whole pool drains to honest peers and every identity of that operator loses its epoch reward. One fake therefore costs at least 758,000 POA, and five fakes drain 2,500,000 POA in pool funds plus 1,290,000 POA in rewards.
